firm_note.text: Stableford Capital, formed in 2014 and based in Scottsdale, AZ, was founded by Andrew Brinkman and is led by a leadership team with deep institutional investing and tax/finance backgrounds, including Managing Partner Justin Thomas and CFO/CCO Mark Rehn.
firm_note.source: Firm website (stablefordcapital.com/leadership/) and web search corroboration

Mark Rehn.bio_note: Chief Financial Officer & Chief Compliance Officer at Stableford Capital. 35+ years in corporate finance and taxation, including a Tax Director role and Assistant General Counsel/Senior Tax Manager work; holds an LL.M. in Taxation and J.D. from DePaul University College of Law. Authored 'Making Gifts of Appreciated Stock – Time to Switch to Private Foundations?' published in the Journal of Taxation (January 1998), consistent with his tax-attorney background. A Crain's Chicago Business 'People on the Move' page under his name (chicagobusiness.com/people-on-the-move/mark-rehn) is indexed by search engines with the title 'Mark Rehn at Stableford Capital,' matching Crain's standard URL pattern for this feature — but the page itself returns a 404 on every direct access attempt (including Wayback Machine), so its actual content could not be read or confirmed. Treat the specific Crain's coverage as unconfirmed; do not cite it as a fact in outreach.
Mark Rehn.bio_source: SEC IAPD individual adviser record (adviserinfo.sec.gov/individual/summary/2069136) and LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/mark-rehn-a844331/, based in Western Springs, IL, actively reshares Stableford Capital content) independently corroborate identity and Chicago-based tax-professional background. Journal of Taxation authorship (January 1998) independently confirmed via search. Crain's Chicago Business 'People on the Move' page exists per search-engine indexing but its content is unconfirmed — direct fetch and Wayback Machine access both failed.

firm_note.text: Luminescent Wealth Management, Inc. is a boutique, independently-owned, fee-only RIA in Scottsdale, AZ, co-founded in 2025 by Erin Itkoe and Trevor Scheid, both of whom previously worked together at Tarbox Family Office and Versant Capital Management before starting the firm.

Erin Beth Itkoe.bio_note: Confirmed as the same person previously at Tarbox Family Office (Director, Financial Planning) who left to co-found Luminescent Wealth Management with Trevor Scheid in 2025. Career began in 2003; prior roles include Director of Financial Planning at Tarbox Family Office, Senior Wealth Counselor and Director of Client Experience at Versant Capital Management, and Manager of Investment Operations/Relationship Manager at GenSpring Family Offices. CPA/PFS and CFP, also an Accredited Estate Planner and Chartered Advisor in Philanthropy. Named one of Az Business Magazine's '12 Millennials to Watch' (2019), listed at Versant Capital Management, age 38, noted as president of the Financial Planning Association of Greater Phoenix. In June 2017, while a Senior Wealth Counselor at Versant Capital Management, she was one of 16 CPAs age 40 and under honored by the AICPA with the second annual Personal Financial Planning (PFP) Standing Ovation award, recognized at the AICPA's Advanced Personal Financial Planning Conference (AICPA ENGAGE) in Las Vegas.
Erin Beth Itkoe.bio_source: '12 Millennials to Watch' independently confirmed via the original AZ Big Media article (azbigmedia.com/business/business-leaders/newsmakers/12-millennials-to-watch-in-2019/). AICPA Standing Ovation award independently confirmed via Versant Capital Management's own press coverage (versantcm.com/insights/news/standing-ovation-top-young-cpa-personal-financial-planning/ and versantcm.com/insights/news/top-cpa-personal-financial-planning/), corroborated by AICPA's own 2017 press release 'AICPA Announces Standing Ovation Honors in Personal Financial Planning' and syndicated coverage on AdvisorNews.com — no longer solely sourced to the firm's own bio page.
